source_text: Accesserunt ad Moysen omnes qui erant principes. Ordines in ecclesia et accessus ad verbum. Gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Approached to Moses all who were leaders. Orders in church and approach to word. Glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[All the leaders approached Moses >> Bible:Numbers 31:48 / 32]]. Orders in the church and approach to the word. Glory forever. Amen.
